<!-- Supp: closes the vision-CNN gap. Linked from convseq2seq + transformer (ResNet residual). -->

::: {.callout-tip title="TL;DR" icon="false"}
The convolutional lineage that owned computer vision: **LeNet** (1998) → **AlexNet**
(2012, the ImageNet inflection) → **VGG** (depth) → **ResNet** (2015, residual
connections that made very deep nets trainable — the same shortcut the Transformer
block reuses).
:::

**Depends on:** [MLP & Backpropagation](../00_foundations/04_mlp_backprop.qmd)

## The mechanism

### Convolution and pooling: weight sharing + locality

### AlexNet (2012) — the ImageNet inflection

### VGG — depth via small filters

### ResNet — residual connections unlock depth
